preflight_interpretation: Author first ran all16 synthetic cases successfully but initial lint failed; final test-only changes were covered by7 affected passing cases and clean Ruff. Passing tests were not redundantly rerun by reviewer.
scope: Final source/protocol and synthetic fixture inspection only; no test rerun, real preparation decode, tokenizer, model or cost execution by reviewer.
verified_contracts: Fixed complete schedule:40 cells,52 optimizer updates,1168 training dialogue visits,24 DEV forwards,412 parity dialogue encodings;1604 total encoder passes.
Full prepared closure/source/runtime and exact metadata cases authenticated before backend/model dispatch.
Fresh identical encoder and scalar initialization digests across all cells and arms; actual V2 state checks remain on the complete public stream.
Only scored time/query coordinates select loss geometry; synthetic targets and strata use fixed support and offset, not official values or bins.
Every training microbatch uses the same effective-batch endpoint denominator; final fixture directly witnesses unequal2+1 endpoint counts using denominator3 and single-dialogue count2.
DEV cases use no-grad forward-only execution and preserve initial encoder digest; final fixture checks no gradient witness is emitted for evaluation.
Actual encoder dispatches, attempted/returned operations, work totals, monitored states, checkpoints and all warm/measured cells are accounted for.

Event time includes assembly,encoding,recurrence,loss,backward,optimizer,validation and synchronization. Journal-write duration is recorded after append only in cell summaries and is charged to whole-phase wall time.
Exclusive failure preservation disables alarm, guards original exceptions and demotes any premature completed marker; no retry/resume path.
